name: smwgraphics-porky-pig-s-haunted-holiday-well
title: Porky Pig's Haunted Holiday  - Well
description:
A foreground tileset used in the well areas in the ghost town level from Porky Pig's Haunted Holiday for the SNES. Credit isn't required if you use this, but it would be appreciated.

Note: This foreground comes with background tiles, although you could move all the tiles in this set onto one layer if you want to without much trouble.
